outline: This course introduces material's elastic and plastic response under static and dynamic loads. The content of this course includes Material science, heat treatment, dislocation plasticity, and strengthening mechanisms of materials. Material's failure mechanisms including yielding, fracture, fatigue, creep, and others will also be discussed.
schedule:
Introduction (week 1)
1. Structure and Deformation in Materials (week 2-3)
2. A Survey of Engineering Materials (week 4-5)
3. Mechanical Testing methods (week 6-7)
-------Mid-term report------- (week 8)
4. Stress-strain relationships (week 9-11)
5. Fracture mechanics (week 12-13)
6. Theory of plasticity (week 14-16)
-------Final report------- (week 17)
scorePolicy:
This is a full English course. Student is required to do a full presentation in English in order to pass.

Homework and attendance 30%
mid term exam 35%
final presentation/report 35%
materials: Mechanical Behavior of Materials 5/E by Norman E. Dowling
